All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10A.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of a Density Bonus, Design Review Permit, Boundary Adjustment and Coastal Development Permit for the demolition of four (4) existing commercial structures and parking areas, and construction of a multi-family residential and mixed-use development consisting of 94 residential apartments (75 market rate and 19 low income units) within four residential podium buildings, a two-level underground parking structure, four (4) mixed-use (residential and commercial) buildings, two (2) commercial buildings, a 34-room hotel with eight (8) economy/affordable rooms, private amenity and common open space, grading, streetscape and landscaping improvements, and two (2) temporary construction trailers. Contact Person: Planning Manager Colamussi
CASE NUMBER: MULTI-003780-2020, BADJ-003787-2020, CDP-003788-2020, DR-003786-2020; APPLICANT: Encinitas Beach Land Venture I, LLC, Lawrence Jackel; APPELLANT: Friends of Seabluffe c/o DeLano & DeLano; LOCATION: 1900 and 1950 North Coast Highway 101 (APNs: 216-041-20, -21 and -06).
Recommended Action: Deny the appeal and adopt draft City Council Resolution No. 2021-93, titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council denying an appeal and affirming the Planning Commission's decision on June 16, 2022 Certifying the Final Environmental Impact Report, Adopting the Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program, and making the required CEQA Findings including Findings of Overriding Considerations and the General Plan overriding public need findings and Approving a Density Bonus, Design Review Permit, Boundary Adjustment and Coastal Development Permit to demolish all existing commercial structures and parking areas and construct 94 residential units, an underground parking structure, four (4) mixed-use commercial buildings, two (2) commercial buildings, a 34-room hotel, grading/site/landscaping improvements, and two (2) temporary construction trailers located at 1900 &1950 North Coast Highway 101. (CASE NOS. MULTI-003780-2020, BADJ-003787-2020, CDP-003788-2020, DR-003786-2020; APNs: 216-041-20, -21 & -06)."

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
